title: Don't Stay Up Late
subtitle: 考点：祈使句 / Don't ..., or you may ...

dialogue.t: I stayed up late last night.
No. I watched a funny video until eleven o'clock.
Don't stay up late, or you may feel unhappy.
You are right. I felt sleepy in class.
Go to bed at nine tonight.

vocab: stay up 熬夜 · tired 累的 · video 视频 · unhappy 不开心的 · sleepy 困的 · funny 有趣的
